Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences

An economic sciences prize established by Sveriges Riksbank in 1968 and first awarded in 1969, with laureates selected by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. Presented every year alongside the Nobel Prizes on 10 December in Stockholm, Sweden. Carries a prize of roughly $1.1 million, split among co-recipients.
Its recipients have influenced economic knowledge, but it is a separate and younger award than the Nobel Prizes.
